Name: Ismaiah the Gibeonite
Summary: Mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty, who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:4: Mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty, who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ismaiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
